010720:                             if (member->is_negative)
010721:                             {
010722:                                 evaluation_tokens[evaluation_token_count++] = c_space_token(&enum_space, S8("-"), C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
010723:                             }
010724:                             evaluation_tokens[evaluation_token_count++] = c_space_token(&enum_space, string_format(temporary.arena, S8("{u64}"), member->value),
010725:                                                                                         C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER, C_PUNCTUATOR_NONE);
010726:                             folded_member = true;
010727:                             break;
010728:                         }
010729:                     }
010730:                     if (!folded_member && expression_token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
010731:                     {
010732:                         String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, expression_token);
010733:                         if (string_equal(spelling, S8("true")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("false")))
010734:                         {
010735:                             evaluation_tokens[evaluation_token_count++] =
010736:                                 c_space_token(&enum_space, string_equal(spelling, S8("true")) ? S8("1") : S8("0"),
010737:                                               C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER, C_PUNCTUATOR_NONE);
010738:                             folded_member = true;
010739:                         }
010740:                         else
010741:                         {
010742:                             c_parse_diagnostic(
010743:                                 result, c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, name), C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_CONSTEXPR,
010744:                                 string_format(result->arena, S8("enumerator '{S8}' is not an integer constant expression"),
010745:                                               c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, name)));
010746:                             expression_valid = false;
010747:                             break;
010748:                         }
010749:                     }
010750:                     if (!folded_member)
010751:                     {
010752:                         evaluation_tokens[evaluation_token_count++] =
010753:                             c_space_retoken(&enum_space, constant_preprocess.spelling_base, expression_token);
010754:                     }
010755:                 }
010756:                 if (expression_valid)
010757:                 {
010758:                     CPreprocessResult evaluation = {
010759:                         .diagnostics = arena_allocate(temporary.arena, CDiagnostic, evaluation_token_count + 1),
010760:                         .target = constant_preprocess.target,
010761:                         .dialect = constant_preprocess.dialect,
010762:                     };
010763:                     u64 evaluated = 0;
010764:                     bool valid = c_integer_expression_evaluate(temporary.arena, enum_space.base, evaluation_tokens,
010765:                                                                evaluation_token_count, 65536, &evaluation, &evaluated);
010766:                     if (!valid || evaluation.diagnostic_count)
010767:                     {
010768:                         c_parse_diagnostic(
010769:                             result, c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, name), C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_CONSTEXPR,
010770:                             string_format(result->arena, S8("enumerator '{S8}' is not an integer constant expression"),
010771:                                           c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, name)));
010772:                     }
010773:                     else if (evaluated <= INT64_MAX)
010774:                     {
010775:                         value = (s64)evaluated;
010776:                     }
010777:                     else
010778:                     {
010779:                         value = -1 - (s64)(UINT64_MAX - evaluated);
010780:                     }
010781:                 }
010782:                 scratch_end(temporary);
010783:             }
010784:             BUSTER_VALIDATE(result->enum_member_count < result->enum_member_capacity);
010785:             result->enum_members[result->enum_member_count++] = (CEnumMember){
010786:                 .name = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, name),
010787:                 .location = c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, name),
010788:                 .symbol = name.symbol,
010789:                 .value = value < 0 ? (u64)(-value) : (u64)value,
010790:                 .is_negative = value < 0,
010791:             };
010792:             previous_value = value;
010793:             enum_start = token_index + 1;
010794:         }
010795:     }
010796:     if (kind != C_TYPE_ENUM)
010797:     {
010798:         // The definition's own attributes sit on either side of the body:
010799:         // `struct __attribute__((packed)) P { ... }` writes them between the
010800:         // keyword and the brace, `struct P { ... } __attribute__((packed));`
010801:         // after the closing one. Both ranges are scanned back to back so the
010802:         // alignment records they append stay one contiguous run.
010803:         bool is_packed = false;
010804:         u32 attribute_alignment_start = 0;
010805:         u32 attribute_alignment_count = 0;
010806:         u32 suffix_end = c_parse_skip_attributes(preprocess, close + 1, end);
010807:         c_parse_layout_attributes(result, preprocess, aggregate_index + 1, open, &is_packed, &attribute_alignment_start, &attribute_alignment_count);
010808:         {
010809:             bool suffix_packed = false;
010810:             u32 suffix_alignment_start = 0;
010811:             u32 suffix_alignment_count = 0;
010812:             c_parse_layout_attributes(result, preprocess, close + 1, suffix_end, &suffix_packed, &suffix_alignment_start, &suffix_alignment_count);
010813:             is_packed |= suffix_packed;
010814:             if (!attribute_alignment_count)
010815:             {
010816:                 attribute_alignment_start = suffix_alignment_start;
010817:             }
010818:             attribute_alignment_count += suffix_alignment_count;
010819:         }
010820:         if (is_packed || attribute_alignment_count)
010821:         {
010822:             // One entry per aggregate, rewritten rather than appended when
010823:             // the definition is parsed again: the type machine rolls a
010824:             // speculative parse back and retries it, and a table that grew on
010825:             // every attempt could outrun the one-per-definition bound its
010826:             // capacity is sized to and start dropping the answer.
010827:             u32 record_index = 0;
010828:             while (record_index < result->aggregate_attribute_count && result->aggregate_attributes[record_index].type_index != type.value)
010829:             {
010830:                 record_index += 1;
010831:             }
010832:             if (record_index < result->aggregate_attribute_count || result->aggregate_attribute_count < result->aggregate_attribute_capacity)
010833:             {
010834:                 result->aggregate_attribute_count += record_index == result->aggregate_attribute_count;
010835:                 result->aggregate_attributes[record_index] = (CAggregateAttributes){
010836:                     .type_index = type.value,
010837:                     .alignment_start = attribute_alignment_start,
010838:                     .alignment_count = attribute_alignment_count,
010839:                     .is_packed = is_packed,
010840:                 };
010841:             }
010842:         }
010843:         frame->type = type;
010844:         frame->original_type_id = type;
010845:         frame->original_type_valid = true;
010846:         frame->definition_type_start = definition_type_start;
010847:         frame->pending_index = definition_type_start;
010848:         frame->close = close;
010849:         frame->has_function_suffix = true;
010850:         *declarator_start = close + 1;
010851:         return type;
010852:     }
010853:     aggregate = &result->types[type.value];
010854:     aggregate->member_count = result->member_count - aggregate->member_start;
010855:     aggregate->enum_member_count = result->enum_member_count - aggregate->enum_member_start;
010856:     aggregate->is_complete = true;
010857:     c_parse_validate_flexible_array_members(result, aggregate);
010858:     u32 enum_declarator_start = close + 1;
010859:     type = c_parse_apply_trailing_qualifiers(result, preprocess, type, &enum_declarator_start, end);
010860:     *declarator_start = enum_declarator_start;
010861:     return type;
010862: }
010863: 
010864: BUSTER_C_SHARED CTypeId c_parse_pointer_chain(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CTypeId base, u32* index, u32 end)
010865: {
010866:     while (*index < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[*index], C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR))
010867:     {
010868:         *index += 1;
010869:         CType pointer = {
010870:             .element_type = base,
010871:             .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
010872:             .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
010873:             .kind = C_TYPE_POINTER,
010874:         };
010875:         while (*index < end && preprocess.tokens[*index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
010876:         {
010877:             String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[*index]);
010878:             if (c_parse_type_qualifier_word(spelling, &pointer))
010879:             {
010880:             }
010881:             else if (string_equal(spelling, S8("_Nonnull")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("_Nullable")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("_Null_unspecified")))
010882:             {
010883:                 /* Nullability affects diagnostics, not the C object
010884:                    representation. */
010885:             }
010886:             else
010887:             {
010888:                 break;
010889:             }
010890:             *index += 1;
010891:         }
010892:         base = c_parse_add_type(result, pointer);
010893:     }
010894:     return base;
010895: }
010896: 
010897: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_parenthesized_declarator_name(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 declarator_start, u32 end, u32* name_index)
010898: {
010899:     if (declarator_start >= end || !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[declarator_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
010900:     {
010901:         return false;
010902:     }
010903:     u32 index = declarator_start + 1;
010904:     while (index < end)
010905:     {
010906:         while (index < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR))
010907:         {
010908:             index += 1;
010909:             CType ignored = {0};
010910:             while (index < end && preprocess.tokens[index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
010911:             {
010912:                 String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index]);
010913:                 if (c_parse_type_qualifier_word(spelling, &ignored) || string_equal(spelling, S8("_Nonnull")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("_Nullable")) ||
010914:                     string_equal(spelling, S8("_Null_unspecified")))
010915:                 {
010916:                     index += 1;
010917:                     continue;
010918:                 }
010919:                 break;
010920:             }
010921:         }
010922:         // A declarator group may hold another one: the name of
010923:         // `void (*(*xDlSym)(sqlite3_vfs*, void*, const char*))(void)` is two
010924:         // groups deep, and it is still the one name the declarator declares.
010925:         if (index < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
010926:         {
010927:             index += 1;
010928:             continue;
010929:         }
010930:         break;
010931:     }
010932:     // Parenthesized declarators may redundantly wrap a plain function name
010933:     // (`extern int (f)(void)`) as well as a function pointer (`int (*f)`).
010934:     // Requiring a `*` here drops the API declarations used by Lua and system
010935:     // headers, leaving every call looking undeclared.
010936:     if (index >= end || preprocess.tokens[index].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
010937:     {
010938:         return false;
010939:     }
010940:     *name_index = index;
010941:     return true;
010942: }
010943: 
010944: // Return the name of a parenthesized function declarator (`(f)(...)` or
010945: // `(*f)(...)`).  The parser's declaration scan normally recognizes a function
010946: // from the identifier immediately before its parameter list; a redundant
010947: // pair of parentheses moves that identifier inside the first group, so keep
010948: // this small shape test shared by the AST and semantic declaration passes.
010949: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_parenthesized_function_name(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 start, u32 end, u32* name_index)
010950: {
010951:     if (start >= end || !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
010952:     {
010953:         return false;
010954:     }
010955:     u32 candidate = 0;
010956:     if (!c_parse_parenthesized_declarator_name(preprocess, start, end, &candidate))
010957:     {
010958:         return false;
010959:     }
010960:     u32 depth = 1;
010961:     u32 close = start + 1;
010962:     while (close < end && depth)
010963:     {
010964:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[close], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
010965:         {
010966:             depth += 1;
010967:         }
010968:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[close], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
010969:         {
010970:             depth -= 1;
010971:         }
010972:         close += 1;
010973:     }
010974:     if (depth || close >= end || !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[close], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
010975:     {
010976:         return false;
010977:     }
010978:     *name_index = candidate;
010979:     return true;
010980: }
